popCulture.title: Theogony (catalogue of rivers)
popCulture.creator: Hesiod
popCulture.description: Hesiod’s Maeander — twisting river-son of Oceanus and Tethys — the Carian stream whose winding course named a pattern.

popCulture.title: meander
popCulture.description: English meander — to wander in winding curves — keeps the Maeander’s name as everyday speech, the river-god’s most durable afterlife.
